remarks: This sunny, 5-bedroom, 3-bath home has been beautifully renovated. The spacious living and dining rooms, with elegant wood floors and a cozy wood-burning fireplace, are perfect for hosting large family gatherings. Guests will be impressed by the stunning eat-in kitchen, quartz countertops, and sleek stainless steel appliances. A beautiful deck overlooks the level 0.25-acre property, ideal for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. The lower level offers additional living space, including a family room with a second fireplace, a bedroom, and a full bath- for in-laws, an au pair, or teenagers. Located in the Glenville neighborhood, this home provides access to all Greenwich offers, including top-rated schools,, libraries, beautiful beaches, and low taxes. Perfect for everyday living!
